FTP::enable
Description
This command enables FTP protocol handler for FTP message processing.
This will enable detection of “AUTH TLS/SSL” for FTP.
Syntax
FTP
::
enable
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
!
([
IP
::
addr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
equals
10.0
.0.0
/
8
])
}
{
FTP
::
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
SERVER_CONNECTED, CLIENT_ACCEPTED
